content.comment_body: Hello, my previous laptop stopped working and I upgraded to a new one. However, during the installation of all my software, I realized that I couldn't locate some CDs, including my [product_name] [version_no] installation disc. I contacted [company_name] support, and they directed me to this forum. Is there any way I can reactivate [product_name] [version_no] without purchasing another license, as I've already paid for the software? I would appreciate any advice or suggestions. Thank you, [user_name].
[company_name] recommended you seek help in this forum? That seems unlikely. I'll contact the moderators for assistance.
Hi [user_name], Since this software version is discontinued, it's not available for download from this forum. You may need to look for alternative sources for the installation. Regards, [user_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience difficulties reinstalling and activating previously purchased software after hardware failure, especially when dealing with discontinued products. There is frustration over the lack of accessible re-download options and support for legacy licenses, leaving users feeling disadvantaged due to the need to repurchase software they already own.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to easily access and reactivate software they have previously purchased, including older or discontinued versions, without needing to buy another license.
